## 📊 Data Sources

The data for this project comes from two primary sources:

1. **Historical Statistics:** Player and pitching statistics from the [Lahman Baseball Database](https://www.seanlahman.com/baseball-archive/statistics/) (accessed via the [Lahman R package](https://cran.r-project.org/package=Lahman)).
2. **Modern Tracking Metrics:** Batted-ball tracking metrics (such as exit velocity and hard-hit rates) from MLB's [Baseball Savant / Statcast](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/).

Together, these datasets allow us to compare pre-Statcast (2005–2014) and Statcast-era (2015–2025) trends across Major League Baseball.
:::
